figures.caption: Table 1: Quantitative comparison with baseline methods on the 100-case test set. CD, EMD, and P2F are reported in mm. Values are mean(std) over each chamber. Red and blue indicate the best and second-best results, respectively. † indicates a statistically significant improvement over the second-best method using a paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test on the same test cases (p < 0.001).
